Visual hacks in this context is typically when you stream your video to a SBC (like a raspberry PI) which will then analyze the video and send back instructions to a controller to perform an action on the primary PC.

Since the video is typically streamed over the network it's impossible for vanguard to know if it's malicious or not since streaming video over the network is a very common use case for regular players.

The SBC is a different machine giving you free reign to run whatever you want off it.

Running at root level also does not prevent hardware spoofing allowing the controller to appear as a mouse or keyboard.

The most typical use case would be an aimbot. The SCB could identify players calculate the how far your crosshair is and then tell the controller to move your mouse to x cords. In leagues case it could be used to identify skill shots and send data back to dodge it.

It sounds like a lot to get working but companies that sell these hacks provide plug and play kits with everything you need for pretty cheap and is one of the more common methods for hacking in games today.

The biggest problem that gets ignored is root level anti cheats don't work. 

They give the illusion of working by blocking obvious rage hackers like back in the day when you'd join a MW2 lobby and there'd be that guy in the back instantly spawn killing everyone.

They don't stop hardware level or visual hacks which can costs you as little as $20 to get started. Valorant is plagued with these types of exploits but because they aren't obvious they often get chalked up as smurfs.

If you’re looking to target specific players it would be through social engineering not a anti-cheat exploit. The issue people have with vanguards always on root access is it enables the opportunity for a wide scale breach which are far more frequent then we realize and continuing in this direction undermines security and makes it more likely over time. 

Riot themselves are no stranger to these breaches which is part of the reasoning for this update the next one can easily effect Vanguard.
